digest.component_or_area: read CLI surfaces and ensure_fresh reconverge path
propositions: Read CLI surfaces (show, list, search, ready) that route through ensure_fresh can return empty stdout with exit 0 under concurrent background push contention, violating output integrity.
The reconverge lock timeout bounds the stall window but a generic property test must verify all read surfaces maintain parseable JSON output or nonzero exit under write-burst + auto-push harness.
Throttle marker /tmp/.ticket-sync-<md5> prevents reconverge on every read; the harness must clear it before each invocation to exercise the contended code path.

Valid empty output serializes as [] in JSON; truncated/empty stdout is distinguishable from legitimate empty results only when parsed as JSON, so exit 0 implies stdout must parse as the surface's documented shape (dict for show, list for list/search/ready).
Reverting _RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT from 2s back to 15s should reproduce the stall under held-write-lock, proving the timeout ledge is necessary for read integrity.
